ayahs.e2: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺
until you end up in ˹your˺ graves

ayahs.en: No! You are going to know
ayahs.e2: But no! You will soon come to know

ayahs.en: Then no! You are going to know
ayahs.e2: Again, no! You will soon come to know

ayahs.en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty
ayahs.e2: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺

ayahs.en: You will surely see the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire

ayahs.en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty
ayahs.e2: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

ayahs.en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure
ayahs.e2: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures
